description: Main source file for a Bluetooth unicast audio server implementation using Zephyr RTOS, handling Bluetooth initialization, audio stream configuration, and data transmission with support for LC3 codec.

methods.name: get_and_incr_seq_num
methods.description: Retrieves and increments the sequence number for a given stream.

methods.name: print_hex
methods.description: Prints data buffer in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: print_cb
methods.description: Callback to print Bluetooth data content.

methods.name: print_codec_cfg
methods.description: Prints details of a Bluetooth audio codec configuration.

methods.name: audio_timer_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback to send mock audio data periodically.

methods.name: stream_dir
methods.description: Determines the direction (source or sink) of a stream.

methods.name: stream_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a stream based on direction.

methods.name: lc3_config
methods.description: Configures LC3 codec for a stream.

methods.name: lc3_reconfig
methods.description: Reconfigures LC3 codec for a stream.

methods.name: lc3_qos
methods.description: Sets QoS parameters for LC3 streams.

methods.name: lc3_enable
methods.description: Enables LC3 codec on a stream.

methods.name: stream_recv_lc3_codec
methods.description: Receives and decodes incoming LC3-encoded audio data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, setting up advertising, and managing connection lifecycle.
